description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerService class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve and instantiate a user role manager based on configuration, ensuring the class exists, is a subclass of AbstractUserRoleManager, and configuring it with the current user context. It utilizes various traits for services like configuration, logging, user management, and authentication.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerService
classes.description: Service class for managing user roles within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving the role manager class name from configuration, instantiating the role manager, and associating it with the current user context.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the configured class name for the user role manager from the system configuration.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Instantiates and returns an object of the user role manager class, ensuring it exists, is a subclass of AbstractUserRoleManager, and sets the current user context.
